name: synthetic insert-if-absent MERGE (orders, in-job drafting)
statement: MERGE INTO default.nightshift_demo.orders_silver t USING default.nightshift_demo.orders_bronze s ON t.order_id = s.order_id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (order_id, customer_id, region, status, amount, quantity, order_date, updated_at) VALUES (s.order_id, s.customer_id, s.region, s.status, s.amount, s.quantity, s.order_date, s.updated_at)

name: synthetic guarded upsert MERGE (orders, grade only)
statement: MERGE INTO default.nightshift_demo.orders_silver t USING default.nightshift_demo.orders_bronze s ON t.order_id = s.order_id WHEN MATCHED AND s.updated_at > t.updated_at THEN UPDATE SET t.customer_id = s.customer_id, t.region = s.region, t.status = s.status, t.amount = s.amount, t.quantity = s.quantity, t.order_date = s.order_date, t.updated_at = s.updated_at WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (order_id, customer_id, region, status, amount, quantity, order_date, updated_at) VALUES (s.order_id, s.customer_id, s.region, s.status, s.amount, s.quantity, s.order_date, s.updated_at)
